name: Parfait with the Detective
source:
"This dull city, at least for today, seems a ittle bit more sweet."

A BL / slice of life Visual Novel where two guys spend their day off in a coffee shop. 

[From [url=https://rocopoco.itch.io/parfait-with-the-detective]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“这座沉闷的城市，至少在今天，似乎多了几分甜蜜。”

一部BL/生活片段视觉小说，讲述了两个人在咖啡店度过一天的故事。

[来自[url=https://rocopoco.itch.io/parfait-with-the-detective]itch.io[/url]]
